Other apps (Samsung Calendar, Google Calendar, Phone, WhatsApp …) can then use them. They appear under the Android account “dmOffice” and are synced both ways: changes, new and deleted entries made there go to dmOffice, changes from dmOffice come back. If an entry was changed on both sides, the dmOffice version wins and yours is kept as a conflict copy. Invitations from others and some special recurrences stay read-only there. The copies in the Android databases are stored unencrypted.
End-to-end envelope to dmOffice active (ECDH P-256, AES-256-GCM): proxy and network only see ciphertext.
Connection over TLS only – the server does not offer the encrypted envelope yet.
Local data is stored encrypted (SQLCipher, key in the Android Keystore). Connection to the server over TLS.

No rules yet. A rule uploads new photos, videos or files from a folder on this phone to a folder in your dmOffice files automatically.

New photos and videos are detected within seconds, even when the app is closed; as a safety net it also checks every 15 minutes (folders chosen by hand only then). The app remembers what it has uploaded; a file whose contents are already anywhere in dmOffice (same checksum, also from another device) is not transferred again.
